Digitalurban in Chile

Andy CASA, UCL East








Digitalurban is off to Concepcion in Chile to present the Inaugural lecture at the 2nd. International Congress on Virtual City and Territory. Posts to the blog may not be possible during the next week, although the panoramic rig is packed and we aim to report on the latest research in digital visualisations and cities.

- Update -

Due to a mix up with dates and then engine failure on the runway Digitalurban never did make Chile. If people are interested however we are giving an open lecture at the University of California, Berkeley on Digital Cities and Digital Earth on Monday 31st October. If you would like details please leave a comment and we'll post up some more info.
